Please review the EvolutionDecision service realization. All 33 tests pass. Covers: full lifecycle (propose->review->approve->execute->cancel/reject), cooldown/observation window policy enforcement per EVOLUTION_COOLDOWN_AND_CONVERGENCE_POLICY.md, actor-role matrix enforcement per EVOLUTION_REVIEW_AND_THRESHOLDS.md, single-active-rule, evidence linkage requirement, threshold evaluator endpoint, and boundary query. Ready for Codex review.

Review changes requested from Codex: fix HTTP boundary validation so invalid evidence/threshold/freeze-mode enums return 4xx instead of uncaught ValueError/500, and wire the evolution service store to the incident store so linked_postmortem_id populates Postmortem.linked_evolution_decision_id per contract.

Both Codex review items fixed and re-tested (37/37 pass, commit c7066fd). Please re-review: (1) invalid evidence ref_type → HTTP 400; invalid freeze_mode → HTTP 400; (2) incident_store wired — linked_postmortem_id pre-validated before decision creation, back-link written via link_evolution_decision() after store.put(). New tests: test_propose_invalid_evidence_ref_type_returns_400, test_execute_invalid_freeze_mode_returns_400, test_propose_with_linked_postmortem_populates_back_link, test_propose_with_unknown_postmortem_returns_422.

Re-review passed: invalid evidence ref_type and invalid freeze_mode now return HTTP 400, linked_postmortem_id is pre-validated and postmortem back-link is written, and services/evolution/test_evolution_service.py passes 37/37.
